description: Agent Education: submit a test score report as sent to a recipient with the official score record: the report with the test, the test date, the candidate, the candidate id, the recipient, the day sent, the total as printed and each section with its name, score as printed and percentile; the official record with the test, the test date, the candidate, the candidate id, its status (reported, under review, withheld or cancelled), the total and each section with its name, score and percentile. The signed report gives the report and the record, the test and test date on each side read as matching or differing, the sections matched with the scores printed unlike the record, the sections the record does not show and those left off, the total on each side and the percentiles printed unlike the record, and counts them, and names a misreported score report: a record that shows the scores under review, withheld or cancelled, a test or test date unlike the record, a section score or total unlike the record and a section the record does not show; then a recorded section left off, a percentile unlike the record and a candidate name or id unlike the record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No section scores on the record, a test or test date missing on either side, a total the record does not show, or a percentile the record does not show leaves the report unverified. A report sent before the test date is refused. Scores compare as printed, numbers as numbers. This check reads whether the numbers match, section for section; it never interprets what a score means. wever_health-lab-check reads a lab summary against the lab report as printed, wever_evaluation-result-check reads an agent evaluation’s claimed figures against its measurements, and wever_agent-trust-scorecard computes an agent’s trust score from its own work and receipts, while the score check reads a test score report against the official score record. Verdict edu_score_misreported, edu_score_partial, edu_score_unverified or edu_score_faithful. POST /api/edu-score-check. Reads the education paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no admissions decision, accreditation judgment, aid eligibility decision or evaluation of academic quality or of any person’s ability, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Education reads supplied education paperwork for consistency between documents: a transcript, a diploma or degree certificate, an enrollment verification letter, an education-issued certificate, a course completion record, a transfer credit evaluation, a financial aid award letter and a test score report. Beside it, the Agent Learning checks such as wever_learning-transfer-check read an agent’s own lessons and learning reports, not human education records, while an education check reads no agent lesson; wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS against the evidence offered for them for DiligenceOps, and those claims stay there; and agent credentials stay with wever_credential-requirements-check, which reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements before payment, and wever_onboarding-credential-check, which reads the credentials issued to a new agent. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-education-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-education/.
